rappel_detail.anchor: slung horn or tree at the notch
rappel_detail.station: Walk 100-200 ft along the ridge from the topout to the minor notch between the westernmost buttress and the higher central buttress, marked by a slung horn or tree.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, angling right over a chockstone tunnel to a dirty ramp with a small cave. A single 70 m rope reaches; a single 60 m can fall short, so with 60s bring two. Then follow the upward-trending gully and ledge system on skier’s left around to the base.
rappel_detail.pull: The chockstone tunnel can snag the rope on the pull.
hazards: Do not descend the obvious gully directly below the notch: it is loose and hazardous.

set.rappels: One rappel from the notch over a chockstone tunnel to a ramp, on a single 70 m rope or two 60s (a single 60 m can fall short), then a traverse back around to the base
